questions.article: Where the Muslim Brotherhood Went Wrong
questions.q: What does the prophetic saying quoted in the article teach about government?
options: ‘As you are, so will be the government upon you’
Government emerges from society; it cannot be imposed.
Government must be seized by force
questions.rationale: According to this prophetic saying, the government always emerges from society. It cannot be imposed from outside.

questions.q: What did astronaut Andriyan Nikolayev want to do when he returned to Earth?
options: This is not what he said.
This is not what he said.
He wanted to kiss the ground.
There is nothing like the Earth in the known universe.
questions.rationale: When I arrived back on Earth, I wanted to kiss the ground.

questions.article: From Prophet Abraham to Prophet Muhammad
questions.q: In which city-state was the Prophet Abraham born?
questions.rationale: The Prophet Abraham was born about 2000 years before Christ, in the Sumerian city-state of Ur, which is located in present-day Iraq.

questions.q: What creates the mind-set of an individual, according to the article?
options: The society he is born into
Everyone is a product of his environment.
questions.rationale: Every man is born in a particular society, and it is this society that creates the mind-set of an individual.

questions.q: Of what did Ismael’s wife complain to Prophet Abraham?
options: The story opens the article on positive thinking.
questions.rationale: She complained to him of the severe conditions of life.

questions.q: What does sacrifice teach, according to the article?
options: To acquire something, we must have the courage to give up what we have
It is a living reality, not a soulless ritual.
The article says it is not a soulless ritual.
The article speaks of receiving in return.
questions.rationale: Sacrifice teaches us that if we want to acquire something, we first need to have the courage to give up what we have.

questions.article: The Social Significance of the Sacrifice
questions.q: What does the Eid ul-Azha sacrifice symbolize?
options: The start of the new year
The moulding and making of a pure life
Though today it has become an annual ritual.
questions.rationale: It symbolizes the moulding and making of a pure life.

questions.q: Which philosopher said, “Life is a shipwreck, but we must not forget to sing in the lifeboats”?
options: The article draws from it that opportunities never cease.
questions.rationale: Voltaire (1694-1778), the well-known French philosopher, once commented: Life is a shipwreck, but we must not forget to sing in the lifeboats.

questions.q: According to the Hadith cited, what will one who has lived long not have before God?
options: Life was long enough to take warning.
questions.rationale: The one who has reached old age or who has lived long will have no excuse to present before God.
